description: The Cyberflex Access 64K smart card can be employed in solutions which provide secure PKI (public key infrastructure) and digital signature technology. Cyberflex Access 64K serves as a highly portable, secure token for enhancing the security of network access and ensuring secure electronic communications. Cyberflex Access 64K supports on-card Triple DES and 1024-bit RSA algorithms with on-card key generation. It is compliant to Java Card v2.1.1 and Open Platform v2.0.1. The Cyberflex Access 64K smart card is part of a range of SchlumbergerSema highly secure, Java-based smart cards for physical and logical access, e-transactions and other applications.
